name: llm-wiki
description: Installs and maintains a per-repo codebase knowledge base (.llm-wiki/) so AI coding agents orient fast and use fewer tokens. Tuned for Python, Node.js, T-SQL/SQL Server (sqlproj, SQL scripts, SSIS), PostgreSQL (psql script repos) and R (renv, packages, targets, Quarto, Shiny) repos, plus Slurm/HPC batch jobs. Ships an always-on maintainer skill plus /llm-wiki:init, :update, and :lint commands. Generates pointer files for Claude, Codex/AGENTS.md, and GitHub Copilot.
